summary: import_playbook includes a file of plays and can only be used at the top level of a playbook, not inside a play; it is a core feature, not an overridable module.
questions: How do I chain multiple playbooks together?
Can I use import_playbook inside a play's tasks?

answer_card.title: Import playbooks
answer_card.answer_md: `ansible.builtin.import_playbook` includes a file of plays. Only allowed at the **top level** of a playbook, never inside a play. It's a core feature, not overridable.
